I really enjoyed my meal here! 

The seafood was incredibly fresh, and you could really tell that a lot of care went into preparing each dish. I especially loved the texture of the seafood, and the seasoning was flavorful without being too strong. It really captured the unique taste of Korean cuisine.

Overall, I was very satisfied with both the taste and the portion sizes. If you’re a fan of Korean seafood dishes, I definitely recommend giving this place a try!

I’d love to come back again when I get the chance. It was such a delicious meal!

The best in my experience
Sep 2026 • Couples
I went to three places over 3 nights and 5 days. I came to here, which is Hoangx on the beach in the city, and today is my day of return. I should have come from the first day... It's cleaner than the two restaurants before it, the food comes out faster, and most importantly, it's delicious. The staff are also friendly. Communication is good, but when I go to HoangX, the conversation is difficult and it's chaotic, so I drank 3 cans of beer at Morning Glory before the lobster sashimi came out. Anyway, when you come to Nha Trang, try the seafood here first, and then go somewhere else. You won't regret it.
